title: CI runs scripts/check-symlinks.mjs itself, not only its unit test
evidence: (a) .github/workflows/ci.yml has no step that runs scripts/check-symlinks.mjs or npm run check:symlinks (grep finds neither). (b) CI's unit job runs npm run test:all (ci.yml:157), and vitest.config.ts sets no include, so it picks up tests/check-symlinks.test.ts; that test runs the script in fresh temp git repos built from fixtures (tests/check-symlinks.test.ts:20-33), never on this repo's real docs/products.md, docs/writing-style.md or docs/chatbot/ hashes. (c) CLAUDE.md:62 says the script keeps docs/chatbot/, products.md and writing-style.md real files and checks the synced hashes; package.json:23 puts check:symlinks first in npm test, but CI runs test:all (package.json:26, scripts/test-all-locked.mjs, vitest only), and the ci.yml:153 comment calling test:all a strict superset of npm test is wrong on this point. (d) Found 2026-11-13 on PR 1478 (writing-style.md sync, merged 2026-11-12T23:07Z UTC): it merged on a local node scripts/check-symlinks.mjs run (exit 0) because CI had no such check. The fix is a ci.yml step, a workflow change and so Brad's.
